Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200634 Act Number: 34 Enactment Date: 2006-08-23 Act Year: 2006 Short Title: The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 Hindi Title: खाद्य सुरक्षा और मानक अधिधनयम, 2006 Long Title: An Act to consolidate the laws relating to food and to establish the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India for laying down science based standards for articles of food and to regulate their manufacture, storage, distribution, sale and import, to ensure availability of safe and wholesome food for human consumption and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
